definitions.explanation: A steep wall of natural rock, as in mountains or gorges.

examples.japanese: {岩壁|がんぺき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{登|のぼ}る→登る：00660_noboru⟧。
⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{両側|りょうがわ}→両側：28877_ryougawa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}り{立|た}った→切り立つ：31727_kiritatsu⟧{岩壁|がんぺき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦そびえていた→そびえる：10360_sobieru⟧。
examples.english: Sheer rock walls towered on both sides of the road.

examples.japanese: ⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧クライマー⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{垂直|すいちょく}→垂直：05446_suichoku⟧な{岩壁|がんぺき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{登|のぼ}る→登る：00660_noboru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: Even for experienced climbers, this vertical rock face is hard to climb.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{切|き}り{立|た}った→切り立つ：31727_kiritatsu⟧{岩壁|がんぺき}: a sheer rock wall
- {岩壁|がんぺき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{登|のぼ}る→登る：00660_noboru⟧: to climb a rock face
- ⟦{垂直|すいちょく}→垂直：05446_suichoku⟧な{岩壁|がんぺき}: a vertical rock face

WATCH OUT:
⟦{岸壁|がんぺき}→岸壁：19675_ganpeki⟧, with the same reading, is a quay or wharf where ships moor.
